note: After the revision by Constantino (1995), the original in English. That work describes the soldier and the large worker, the alate being recorded in the original as unknown; the soldier antennal segment count is truncated in the OCR text and has not been adopted. The measurements are from a single large worker. OCR noise (e.g. "ccnered" = covered, "fiti" = 66) has been interpreted from the context.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is clearly distinguished from the other species of the genus by its short mandibles, dense pilosity, wrinkled anterior part of the head and short thoracic spines; its hindgut resembles only that of S. praecellens.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule short, sides parallel; head length without mandibles nearly equal to head width; posterior margin of the head distinctly trilobed and irregularly coarsely wrinkled. Frontal tube projecting, its aperture not visible in dorsal view. Labrum short, length nearly equal to width; lateral corners nearly right-angled; median lobe short. Antennal segment count defective in the original.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Large worker: head sparsely covered with erect setae; fontanelle round and small; antennae 20-segmented; spines of the thoracic tergites very short. The mandibles are poorly preserved in the only available specimen; the worker hindgut was not dissected. Measurements: head length 2.85 mm, maximum head width 3.40 mm, fontanelle length 0.17 mm, pronotum width 2.25 mm, metanotum width 2.25 mm, hind tibia length 4.75 mm.
